items.quote: I would say probably between 26%, 27% growth we should deliver now on a full year basis

items.quote: the longer-term growth guidance of 23% to 25%
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: we have to deliver the long-term 20% to 25% profit growth to investors in 19% to 21% return on equity
items.statement: Long-term PAT growth of 20-25% with return on equity of 19-21%

items.quote: In general, our guidance of 16% to 18%
items.speaker: Rajeev Jain

items.quote: I had given a guidance of 10 to 15 basis point compression in the current year

tone.label: mixed
